raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy and all historical data use America/Chicago local time. As a result, v2 evening transactions land 6 hours late: they show up at 00:00-06:00 and spill into the wrong business date (the 41 rows on 2026-01-19 and 37 early-morning rows on 2026-01-18).", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH src AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM src WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
